periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented vertically at approximately 70-80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, dipping toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval profile with a vertical height significantly exceeding the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering observed, with the lower extremity of the patch narrowing as it approaches the muzzle area.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Smooth, broad U-shaped curve along the posterior edge of the shoulder band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band covering approximately one-third of the visible torso area between the neck and hindquarters.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral displacement on the cranium, with the inter-ear gap roughly 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semicircular apex with no observed irregularities or flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow tinting of the fur on the hind limbs and lower abdominal region, contrasting with the white dorsal fur.
